_comment: Single source of truth for pricing. Volume tiers are MARGINAL: discount applies only to licences within each band, not to the whole order. Calculation: sum across bands of (licences_in_band × base_price × (1 - discount)).

single_academy.period_long: per learner per year · one academy only · volume discounts apply

all_access.period_long: per learner per year · all four academies · volume discounts apply

individual_all_access.period_long: per learner per year · billed annually · cancel anytime

individual_all_access_monthly.period_long: per learner per month · billed monthly · cancel anytime
